- SIG_Questionnaire_2026.pdf (flattened PDF)

Hi Bethany — thanks for the clear checklist. We can support the workflow you outlined; below is our recommended packaging and signer flow so the upload meets both OneTrust and Whistic expectations:

Packaging (recommended):
- Create a flattened SIG PDF (SIG_Questionnaire_ParkView_20260615.pdf).
- Produce per-control evidence PDFs in an evidence/ folder named by control (e.g., evidence/CC6.1-incident-response.pdf).
- Generate manifest.csv (columns: filename, relative_path, control_id, SHA256, file_size_bytes, uploader_email, created_at).
- Create a one-page signed manifest summary (signed_manifest.pdf) that we will send through DocuSign to your legal contact; once signed we include it both as a separate file and as the first page of the ZIP root README.pdf.
- Zip naming: ParkView_SIG_Redwood_20260615_v1.zip

Checksums & verification: we will compute SHA256 for every file and include it in manifest.csv. We can also provide a small attachments-checksum.txt at root with the same values for quick portal ingestion.

Portal behavior differences (short):
- OneTrust: prefers a single ZIP + manifest and will import attachments, but it strips some metadata. Keep filenames simple (<100 chars) and avoid non-ascii. Also split files >20MB into parts or provide direct S3 links for large artifacts.
- Whistic: often prefers per-item uploads with the control mapping done in their UI; we will provide a CSV mapped to Whistic control IDs if you want us to push items individually.

Transfer options:
- Preferred: we upload the zip to an S3 pre-signed link you supply or to a OneTrust portal portal upload URL.
- Alternate: we can provision a secure SFTP/S3 transfer and then post the OneTrust upload on your behalf.

Signer routing (DocuSign):
- We will prepare a DocuSign envelope for the manifest summary. Please confirm signer emails and the order (legal > procurement). If you confirm recipients by EOD tomorrow we can have the envelope ready the following day.

I attached a sample manifest template and an OT upload CSV template for your procurement team to review.

Next steps / asks:
- Bethany: confirm DocuSign recipients (name + email) and whether ParkView will provide the OneTrust portal upload link or prefer Redwood to push and confirm.
- Marissa / Rishi: I asked Rishi to estimate time to flatten and generate the per-control PDFs and checksums; Rishi — can you scope this and share ETA?

Happy to jump on a short call if helpful.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachments: sig_manifest_v1.csv (csv, 4KB), ot_upload_template.csv (csv, 2KB)
